title: Quality +
description: Quality+ is a lightweight enhancement modpack that upgrades the overall feel of Minecraft. It adds realistic touches and small improvements to make the world more immersive while keeping the vanilla experience intact.
body:
**Quality +** is a lightweight Fabric modpack focused on **performance**, **quality of life**, and **realism**. It keeps the vanilla feel while improving FPS, visuals, and usability, and makes Minecraft feel more realistic. ## What's Included - **Performance** — Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, and Perf Boost for smoother gameplay - **Visuals** — Iris Shaders support, 3D Skin Layers, and extra Sodium options for a more realistic look - **Quality of Life** — Xaero's Minimap & World Map, AppleSkin hunger info, and Client Tweaks - **Trinkets** — Accessory slots with Elytra Trinket support Perfect for players who want better performance, QoL, and a more realistic Minecraft experience without changing core gameplay.
📋 Mod List (click to expand) - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) - [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) - [Trinkets Canary](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-canary) - [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) - [Client Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/client-tweaks) - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) - [Perf Boost](https://modrinth.com/mod/perf-boost) - [Elytra Trinket](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra_trinket) - [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm) - [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) - [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
